assignments.blocks: Confirm the first journey and implement visit/task/review/reporting behavior with permitted data; no promised stock counts, priorities or KPI outcomes.

Keep uncertain matches uncertain; define evaluation criteria and gather independent evidence before claiming recognition performance or real stock counts.

Future C4a/C4b field tests must verify reproducible foundations, integration failures and human correction independently; the concept remains explicitly limited.
